body:
## Summary

Implements a Superpowers-style reliability layer for agent-careflow so Claude, Codex, and future subagents work from durable case/plan/order/result/evidence artifacts instead of chat memory.

Key changes:

- Vendors `obra/superpowers` under `third_party/superpowers` for local inspection and traceability.
- Adds native careflow skills for intake, planning, execution, reviews, debugging, worktrees, parallel dispatch, branch finishing, and completion verification.
- Adds SessionStart/Stop hook behavior, fixed handoff headers, guarded mutation/completion checks, and Codex wrapper mitigation for non-interactive prompt-hook gaps.
- Adds durable `.careflow/INDEX.md` and `.agent/` operator workspace generation.
- Adds review exchange/status/import flows, strict business review gates, private Codex-only profile support, and Claude auth diagnostics.
- Adds objective audit/matrix acceptance coverage for the original requirements.
- Adds the ORD-024 continuation pass: hook fail-closed handling for namespaced tools, stricter doctor checks for Codex hooks and ai-dlc setup, repo-relative generated artifact paths, current plan-hash reconciliation, and command-policy hardening so normal branch publishing is allowed while force/mirror push remains blocked.
- Adds the ORD-025 completion audit proving the PR branch/body/comments are current, private/Codex-only acceptance passes, and the only remaining business blocker is external strict Claude review evidence.

## Residual Work

Business-mode completion is still intentionally blocked until a real strict Claude review artifact is imported. The current local Claude CLI cannot authenticate, and the latest user decision was to skip Claude auth/CLI remediation. The expected path is:

1. `agent-careflow review export --case ACF-RELIABILITY-SUPERPOWERS --tool claude --order ORD-024 --review-id REVIEW-CLAUDE-ORD-024 --output /tmp/REVIEW-CLAUDE-ORD-024.request.md`
2. Run the review from an already authenticated Claude environment.
3. `agent-careflow review import --case ACF-RELIABILITY-SUPERPOWERS --source /path/to/REVIEW-CLAUDE-ORD-024.review.md --strict --force`
4. `agent-careflow review require --case ACF-RELIABILITY-SUPERPOWERS --tool codex --tool claude --strict`

Private/Codex-only acceptance passes. Business acceptance remains strict-failing until real Claude review evidence exists.

## Validation

- `uv run --with pytest tests/test_hooks.py tests/test_doctor.py tests/test_policy.py tests/test_dashboard.py tests/test_workspace.py -q` passed: 39 tests.
- `uv run --with pytest -q` passed: 149 tests.
- `agent-careflow doctor --case ACF-RELIABILITY-SUPERPOWERS --ai-dlc-root . --strict-hooks --strict-ai-dlc` passed.
- `agent-careflow acceptance objective-matrix --case ACF-RELIABILITY-SUPERPOWERS --profile private` passed after ORD-025 dashboard/workspace refresh.
- `agent-careflow acceptance objective-matrix --case ACF-RELIABILITY-SUPERPOWERS --profile business` fails as expected only on strict Claude review/completion audit.
- `agent-careflow review status --case ACF-RELIABILITY-SUPERPOWERS --profile private --order ORD-024` passed.
- `agent-careflow review status --case ACF-RELIABILITY-SUPERPOWERS --profile business --order ORD-024` fails as expected because the Claude review artifact is a strict-invalid placeholder.
- `agent-careflow result validate --case ACF-RELIABILITY-SUPERPOWERS --result ORD-025.result.md` passed.
- `agent-careflow order status --case ACF-RELIABILITY-SUPERPOWERS --order ORD-025` reports complete.
- PR #1 comments and review threads are empty as of ORD-025.
- Claude CLI auth diagnostic captured the local blocker: `Not logged in · Please run /login`.

## Notes

This PR intentionally does not include the separate dotfiles repository worktree. That repository has its own uncommitted/ahead state and should be published separately if desired.
